continueBtn.Parent = frame

local contCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
contCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
contCorner.Parent = continueBtn

continueBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    -- Copy to clipboard
    if setclipboard then
        pcall(function() setclipboard("https://discord.gg/Kb3GEdsVFV") end)
    end
    
    -- Visual feedback
    continueBtn.Text = "Copied! Loading script..."
    continueBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 100, 0)
    continueBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 255, 200)
    
    task.wait(1) -- Wait 1 second before loading
    popup:Destroy()
    
   
    local ok, Library = pcall(function() return loadstring(game:HttpGet(AIRFLOW_URL, true))() end)
    if not ok or type(Library) ~= "table" then 
        local err = Instance.new("ScreenGui", CoreGui)
        local lbl = Instance.new("TextLabel", err)
        lbl.Size = UDim2.new(1,0,0,50)
        lbl.Text = "[Visuals] Failed to load AirFlow UI: " .. tostring(Library)
        lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1,0,0)
        lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        lbl.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        lbl.TextSize = 20
        return 
    end

    local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
    local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
    local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
    local Drawingnew = Drawing.new
    local Color3fromRGB = Color3.fromRGB
    local Vector3new = Vector3.new
    local Vector2new = Vector2.new
    local mathfloor = math.floor

    local Connections = {}
    local function Track(c) table.insert(Connections, c); return c end

    local Env = { Fullbright=false, NoFog=false, NoShadows=false, NoPostFX=false, ClearWater=false, NoLeaves=false, ForcedTime=-1 }
    local Original = {
        Brightness=Lighting.Brightness, Ambient=Lighting.Ambient, OutdoorAmbient=Lighting.OutdoorAmbient,
        FogEnd=Lighting.FogEnd, GlobalShadows=Lighting.GlobalShadows, ClockTime=Lighting.ClockTime,
        AtmosphereDensity=(Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere") and Lighting.Atmosphere.Density) or 0.3,
        WaterColor=workspace.Terrain and workspace.Terrain.WaterColor or Color3.new(),
        WaterTransparency=workspace.Terrain and workspace.Terrain.WaterTransparency or 0.5,
    }

    Track(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        pcall(function()
            Lighting.Brightness = Env.Fullbright and 2 or Original.Brightness
            Lighting.Ambient = Env.Fullbright and Color3fromRGB(255,255,255) or Original.Ambient
            Lighting.OutdoorAmbient = Env.Fullbright and Color3fromRGB(255,255,255) or Original.OutdoorAmbient
            local atm = Lighting:FindFirstChildOfClass("Atmosphere")
            if atm then atm.Density = Env.NoFog and 0 or Original.AtmosphereDensity end
            Lighting.FogEnd = Env.NoFog and 1000000 or Original.FogEnd
            Lighting.GlobalShadows = Env.NoShadows and false or Original.GlobalShadows
            Lighting.ClockTime = Env.ForcedTime > -1 and Env.ForcedTime or Original.ClockTime
            if workspace.Terrain then
                workspace.Terrain.WaterColor = Env.ClearWater and Color3fromRGB(255,255,255) or Original.WaterColor
                workspace.Terrain.WaterTransparency = Env.ClearWater and 1 or Original.WaterTransparency
            end
            for _, c in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
                if c:IsA("BloomEffect") or c:IsA("BlurEffect") or c:IsA("SunRaysEffect") or c:IsA("ColorCorrectionEffect") then
                    c.Enabled = not Env.NoPostFX
                end
            end
        end)
    end))

    local function ToggleLeaves(state)
        for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj.Name == "Leaves" or obj.Name == "Fern" then
                if obj:IsA("MeshPart") or obj:IsA("Model") then pcall(function() obj.Transparency = state and 1 or 0 end) end
            end
        end
    end

    local PosCache, PosCacheTimes = {}, {}
    local function FastPos(model)
        if not model then return nil end
        local now = tick()
        local c = PosCache[model]
        if c and (now - (PosCacheTimes[model] or 0)) < 2 and c.Parent == model.Parent then return c.Position end
        local pos
        local ok, pivot = pcall(function() return model:GetPivot().Position end)
        if ok and pivot then pos = pivot
        elseif model.PrimaryPart then pos = model.PrimaryPart.Position
        else local part = model:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"); pos = part and part.Position end
        if pos then PosCache[model] = { Position = pos, Parent = model.Parent }; PosCacheTimes[model] = now end
        return pos
    end

    local function CharPos(char)
        if not char then return nil end
        for _, n in ipairs({"HumanoidRootPart","UpperTorso","LowerTorso","Head","FustBodyCollider"}) do
            local p = char:FindFirstChild(n)
            if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then return p.Position end
        end
        return nil
    end

    local ChamsFolder = Instance.new("Folder", (gethui and gethui()) or CoreGui)

    local function UpdateHighlight(hl, enabled, color, outline)
        if not hl then return end
        hl.Enabled = enabled
        if enabled then
            hl.FillColor = color
            hl.OutlineColor = outline and Color3fromRGB(0,0,0) or color
            hl.OutlineTransparency = outline and 0 or 1
            hl.FillTransparency = 0.5
        end
    end

    local function CreateDraw()
        local d = {
            box = Drawingnew("Square"), name = Drawingnew("Text"), dist = Drawingnew("Text"),
            weapon = Drawingnew("Text"), healthBar = Drawingnew("Line"), healthBarOutline = Drawingnew("Line"),
            cham = Instance.new("Highlight", ChamsFolder)
        }
        d.box.Thickness = 1; d.box.Outline = true; d.box.Filled = false
        d.name.Center = true; d.name.Outline = true; d.name.Font = 2
        d.dist.Center = true; d.dist.Outline = true; d.dist.Font = 2
        d.weapon.Center = true; d.weapon.Outline = true; d.weapon.Font = 2
        d.healthBar.Thickness = 1; d.healthBarOutline.Thickness = 3
        return d
    end

    local function HideDraw(d)
        if not d then return end
        d.box.Visible = false; d.name.Visible = false; d.dist.Visible = false
        d.weapon.Visible = false; d.healthBar.Visible = false; d.healthBarOutline.Visible = false
        d.cham.Enabled = false
    end

    local function DestroyDraw(d)
        if not d then return end
        pcall(function() d.box:Remove() end); pcall(function() d.name:Remove() end)
        pcall(function() d.dist:Remove() end); pcall(function() d.weapon:Remove() end)
        pcall(function() d.healthBar:Remove() end); pcall(function() d.healthBarOutline:Remove() end)
        pcall(function() d.cham:Destroy() end)
    end

    local function ComputeBox(pos, heightStuds)
        local h = heightStuds or 3
        local top = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(pos + Vector3new(0, h/2, 0))
        local bottom = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(pos - Vector3new(0, h/2, 0))
        if top.Z <= 0 or bottom.Z <= 0 then return nil end
        local height = math.abs(bottom.Y - top.Y)
        if height < 1 then height = 30 end
        local width = height / 2
        if width < 1 then width = 15 end
        return Vector2new(top.X - width/2, top.Y), Vector2new(width, height)
    end

    local ESP = { Master=true, MaxDistance=600, FontSize=13, DrawBox=false, DrawName=true, DrawDistance=true, DrawChams=false,
        ShowSulfurNode=false, ShowMetalNode=false, ShowStoneNode=false, ShowTree=false,
        ShowHemp=false, ShowMushroom=false, ShowWoodPile=false, ShowStonePile=false,
        ShowSulfurOrePile=false, ShowMetalOrePile=false, ShowBerryBush=false, ShowCarrotPlant=false, ShowPotatoPlant=false,
        ShowLootCrate=false, ShowLootBarrel=false, ShowMilitaryCrate=false, ShowAirdrops=false }

    local Colors = { Sulfur=Color3fromRGB(255,255,100), Metal=Color3fromRGB(180,180,200), Stone=Color3fromRGB(200,140,90),
        Wood=Color3fromRGB(120,220,130), Hemp=Color3fromRGB(200,255,120), Mushroom=Color3fromRGB(255,170,220),
        Berry=Color3fromRGB(255,100,160), Carrot=Color3fromRGB(255,150,60), Potato=Color3fromRGB(230,200,120),
        Loot=Color3fromRGB(255,90,255), Military=Color3fromRGB(255,60,60), Airdrop=Color3fromRGB(255,240,100) }

    local P = { Enabled=false, MaxDistance=0, FontSize=13, Box=true, BoxColor=Color3fromRGB(255,60,60),
        Name=true, NameColor=Color3fromRGB(255,255,255), Distance=true, DistanceColor=Color3fromRGB(255,255,255),
        HealthBar=true, HealthBarSize=3, Chams=false, ChamColor=Color3fromRGB(255,60,60),
        SleeperEnabled=false, SleeperMaxDistance=0, SleeperFontSize=13, SleeperBox=true, SleeperName=true,
        SleeperDistance=true, SleeperChams=false, SleeperColor=Color3fromRGB(160,160,255) }

    local T = { Vehicles=false, VehMaxDist=0, VehFontSize=13, VehBox=true, VehName=true, VehDist=true, VehChams=false, VehColor=Color3fromRGB(0,200,255),
        AI=false, AIMaxDist=0, AIFontSize=13, AIBox=true, AIName=true, AIDist=true, AIChams=false, AIColor=Color3fromRGB(255,60,60),
        AIFilterGuards=true, AIFilterScavengers=true, AIFilterAnimals=true }

    local D = { Enabled=false, MaxDistance=1000, FontSize=13, Box=true, Name=true, Chams=true,
        ShowTC=true, ShowBoxes=true, ShowFurnaces=true, ShowWorkbenches=true, ShowTraps=true, ShowOther=false,
        ColorEnemy=Color3fromRGB(255,60,60), ColorOwn=Color3fromRGB(60,255,60) }

    local ResourceDraws = {}
    local ResourceFilters = {
        Nodes = {
            { match="SulfurNode", tag="Sulfur", color=Colors.Sulfur, key="ShowSulfurNode" },
            { match="MetalNode", tag="Metal", color=Colors.Metal, key="ShowMetalNode" },
            { match="StoneNode", tag="Stone", color=Colors.Stone, key="ShowStoneNode" },
            { match="Tree", tag="Wood", color=Colors.Wood, key="ShowTree" },
        },
        Pickups = {
            { match="Hemp", tag="Hemp", color=Colors.Hemp, key="ShowHemp" },
            { match="Mushroom", tag="Mushroom", color=Colors.Mushroom, key="ShowMushroom" },
            { match="WoodPile", tag="Wood", color=Colors.Wood, key="ShowWoodPile" },
            { match="StonePile", tag="Stone", color=Colors.Stone, key="ShowStonePile" },
            { match="SulfurOrePile", tag="Sulfur", color=Colors.Sulfur, key="ShowSulfurOrePile" },
            { match="MetalOrePile", tag="Metal", color=Colors.Metal, key="ShowMetalOrePile" },
            { match="BerryBush", tag="Berry", color=Colors.Berry, key="ShowBerryBush" },
            { match="CarrotPlant", tag="Carrot", color=Colors.Carrot, key="ShowCarrotPlant" },
            { match="PotatoPlant", tag="Potato", color=Colors.Potato, key="ShowPotatoPlant" },
        },
        Loot = {
            { match="LootCrate", tag="Crate", color=Colors.Loot, key="ShowLootCrate" },
            { match="LootBarrel", tag="Barrel", color=Colors.Loot, key="ShowLootBarrel" },
            { match="MilitaryCrate", tag="Military", color=Colors.Military, key="ShowMilitaryCrate" },
        },
        Airdrops = { { match="", tag="Airdrop", color=Colors.Airdrop, key="ShowAirdrops" } },
    }

    local resourceAccum = 0
    Track(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        resourceAccum = resourceAccum + dt
        if resourceAccum < 0.066 then return end
        resourceAccum = 0
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not ESP.Master or not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            for _, d in pairs(ResourceDraws) do HideDraw(d) end
            return
        end
        local myPos = char.HumanoidRootPart.Position
        local seen = {}
        local function Process(path, list)
            local folder = workspace
            for _, n in ipairs(path) do folder = folder and folder:FindFirstChild(n) end
            if not folder then return end
            for _, obj in ipairs(folder:GetChildren()) do
                for _, rule in ipairs(list) do
                    if ESP[rule.key] and (rule.match == "" or obj.Name:find(rule.match)) then
                        local pos = FastPos(obj)
                        if pos and (myPos - pos).Magnitude <= ESP.MaxDistance then
                            seen[obj] = true
                            if not ResourceDraws[obj] then ResourceDraws[obj] = CreateDraw() end
                            local d = ResourceDraws[obj]
                            local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
                            if onScreen then
                                local boxPos, boxSize = ComputeBox(pos, 3)
                                if boxPos then
                                    d.box.Size = boxSize; d.box.Position = boxPos
                                    d.box.Color = rule.color; d.box.Visible = ESP.DrawBox
                                    d.name.Text = rule.tag; d.name.Size = ESP.FontSize
                                    d.name.Position = Vector2new(sp.X, boxPos.Y - 18)
                                    d.name.Color = rule.color; d.name.Visible = ESP.DrawName
                                    d.dist.Text = "[" .. mathfloor((myPos-pos).Magnitude) .. "m]"
                                    d.dist.Size = ESP.FontSize - 1
                                    d.dist.Position = Vector2new(sp.X, boxPos.Y + boxSize.Y + 2)
                                    d.dist.Color = rule.color; d.dist.Visible = ESP.DrawDistance
                                    d.weapon.Visible = false
                                    d.healthBar.Visible = false; d.healthBarOutline.Visible = false
                                    d.cham.Adornee = obj
                                    UpdateHighlight(d.cham, ESP.DrawChams, rule.color, true)
                                end
                            else HideDraw(d) end
                        end
                        break
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        Process({"Nodes"}, ResourceFilters.Nodes); Process({"Pickups"}, ResourceFilters.Pickups)
        Process({"Loot"}, ResourceFilters.Loot); Process({"Airdrops"}, ResourceFilters.Airdrops)
        for obj, d in pairs(ResourceDraws) do
            if not seen[obj] then HideDraw(d); if not obj.Parent then DestroyDraw(d); ResourceDraws[obj] = nil end end
        end
    end))

    local PlayerDraws, SleeperDraws = {}, {}
    for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if plr ~= LocalPlayer then PlayerDraws[plr] = CreateDraw() end
    end
    Track(Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(plr) if plr ~= LocalPlayer then PlayerDraws[plr] = CreateDraw() end end))
    Track(Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(plr)
        if PlayerDraws[plr] then DestroyDraw(PlayerDraws[plr]); PlayerDraws[plr] = nil end
    end))

    Track(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            for _, d in pairs(PlayerDraws) do HideDraw(d) end
            for _, d in pairs(SleeperDraws) do HideDraw(d) end
            return
        end
        local localRoot = char.HumanoidRootPart
        if not P.Enabled then
            for _, d in pairs(PlayerDraws) do HideDraw(d) end
        else
            for player, d in pairs(PlayerDraws) do
                local eChar = player.Character
                local visible = false
                if eChar and player:GetAttribute("Alive") == true and player:GetAttribute("Dead") ~= true then
                    local pos = CharPos(eChar)
                    if pos then
                        local dist = (localRoot.Position - pos).Magnitude
                        if P.MaxDistance == 0 or dist <= P.MaxDistance then
                            local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
                            if onScreen then
                                local boxPos, boxSize = ComputeBox(pos, 5.5)
                                if boxPos then
                                    visible = true
                                    d.box.Size = boxSize; d.box.Position = boxPos
                                    d.box.Color = P.BoxColor; d.box.Visible = P.Box
                                    d.name.Text = player.Name; d.name.Size = P.FontSize
                                    d.name.Position = Vector2new(sp.X, boxPos.Y - 18)
                                    d.name.Color = P.NameColor; d.name.Visible = P.Name
                                    d.dist.Text = "[" .. mathfloor(dist) .. "m]"; d.dist.Size = P.FontSize - 1
                                    d.dist.Position = Vector2new(sp.X, boxPos.Y + boxSize.Y + 2)
                                    d.dist.Color = P.DistanceColor; d.dist.Visible = P.Distance
                                    local hum = eChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
                                    if hum and P.HealthBar then
                                        local hp = math.clamp(hum.Health/hum.MaxHealth, 0, 1)
                                        d.healthBar.From = Vector2new(boxPos.X - 5, boxPos.Y + boxSize.Y*(1-hp))
                                        d.healthBar.To = Vector2new(boxPos.X - 5, boxPos.Y + boxSize.Y)
                                        d.healthBar.Color = Color3fromRGB(mathfloor(255*(1-hp)), mathfloor(255*hp), 0)
                                        d.healthBar.Thickness = P.HealthBarSize
                                        d.healthBar.Visible = true
                                        d.healthBarOutline.From = Vector2new(boxPos.X - 5, boxPos.Y - 1)
                                        d.healthBarOutline.To = Vector2new(boxPos.X - 5, boxPos.Y + boxSize.Y + 1)
                                        d.healthBarOutline.Visible = true
                                    else
                                        d.healthBar.Visible = false; d.healthBarOutline.Visible = false
                                    end
                                    d.weapon.Visible = false
                                    d.cham.Adornee = eChar
                                    UpdateHighlight(d.cham, P.Chams, P.ChamColor, true)
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
                if not visible then HideDraw(d) end
            end
        end

        if not P.SleeperEnabled then
            for _, d in pairs(SleeperDraws) do HideDraw(d) end
        else
            local sf = workspace:FindFirstChild("Sleepers")
            local seen = {}
            if sf then
                for _, sleeper in ipairs(sf:GetChildren()) do
                    local pos = CharPos(sleeper)
                    if pos and (P.SleeperMaxDistance == 0 or (localRoot.Position - pos).Magnitude <= P.SleeperMaxDistance) then
                        seen[sleeper] = true
                        if not SleeperDraws[sleeper] then SleeperDraws[sleeper] = CreateDraw() end
                        local d = SleeperDraws[sleeper]
                        local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
                        if onScreen then
                            local boxPos, boxSize = ComputeBox(pos, 5.5)
                            if boxPos then
                                d.box.Size = boxSize; d.box.Position = boxPos
                                d.box.Color = P.SleeperColor; d.box.Visible = P.SleeperBox
                                d.name.Text = sleeper.Name; d.name.Size = P.SleeperFontSize
                                d.name.Position = Vector2new(sp.X, boxPos.Y - 18)
                                d.name.Color = P.SleeperColor; d.name.Visible = P.SleeperName
                                d.dist.Text = "[" .. mathfloor((localRoot.Position-pos).Magnitude) .. "m]"
                                d.dist.Size = P.SleeperFontSize - 1
                                d.dist.Position = Vector2new(sp.X, boxPos.Y + boxSize.Y + 2)
                                d.dist.Color = P.SleeperColor; d.dist.Visible = P.SleeperDistance
                                d.weapon.Visible = false
                                d.healthBar.Visible = false; d.healthBarOutline.Visible = false
                                d.cham.Adornee = sleeper
                                UpdateHighlight(d.cham, P.SleeperChams, P.SleeperColor, true)
                            end
                        else HideDraw(d) end
                    end
                end
            end
            for s, d in pairs(SleeperDraws) do
                if not seen[s] then HideDraw(d); if not s.Parent then DestroyDraw(d); SleeperDraws[s] = nil end end
            end
        end
    end))

    local VehicleDraws = {}
    local vehAccum = 0
    Track(RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
        if not T.Vehicles then
            for _, d in pairs(VehicleDraws) do HideDraw(d) end
            return
        end
        vehAccum = vehAccum + dt
        if vehAccum < 0.05 then return end
        vehAccum = 0
        local char = LocalPlayer.Character
        if not char or not char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then return end
        local myPos = char.HumanoidRootPart.Position
        local seen = {}
        for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
            if obj:IsA("VehicleSeat") and obj.Parent and obj.Parent:IsA("Model") then
                local model = obj.Parent
                local pos = FastPos(model)
                if pos and (T.VehMaxDist == 0 or (myPos - pos).Magnitude <= T.VehMaxDist) then
                    seen[model] = true
                    if not VehicleDraws[model] then VehicleDraws[model] = CreateDraw() end
                    local d = VehicleDraws[model]
                    local sp, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(pos)
                    if onScreen then
                        local boxPos, boxSize = ComputeBox(pos, 4)
                        if boxPos then
                            d.box.Size = boxSize; d.box.Position = boxPos
                            d.box.Color = T.VehColor; d.box.Visible = T.VehBox
                            d.name.Text = model.Name; d.name.Size = T.VehFontSize
                            d.name.Position = Vector2new(sp.X, boxPos.Y - 18)

    }

esp.NewDrawing = function(type, properties)
    local newDrawing = Drawingnew(type)
    for i,v in next, properties or {} do
        newDrawing[i] = v
    end
    return newDrawing
end

    local newCham = Instance.new("Highlight", game.CoreGui)
    for i,v in next, properties or {} do
        newCham[i] = v
    end
    return newCham
end

esp.WallCheck = function(v)
    local ray = Ray.new(camera.CFrame.p, (v.Position - camera.CFrame.p).Unit * 300)
    local part, position = game:GetService("Workspace"):FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {plr.Character, camera}, false, true)
    if part then
        local hum = part.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        if not hum then
            hum = part.Parent.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
        end
        if hum and v and hum.Parent == v.Parent then
            local Vector, Visible = camera:WorldToScreenPoint(v.Position)
            if Visible then
                return true
            end
        end
    end
end

    if plr.TeamColor == v.TeamColor then
        return false
    end
    return true
end
